body.content:
Salesoforce is working on another set of items they want us to work on.
These will be wood screens for seating and desks with rope woven between the slats. 
Please see notes below and let me know if any questions.
  • Screen Size / Shape - Salesforce still working on it. Do not need to quote until they confirm the size
  • Wood - Color will be similar to Oak Natural but to save cost they are OK with any wood like Ash
  • Stability - Since the design is going to be more like page 2 (no top bar) they want to make sure we can make this stable. They do not want to drill the bottom in the floor. 
  • Rope - I think they will prefer Olefin rope to weave between the wood slats
    • Should be flat like the picture, not round like Aomei
    • Size and thickness still TBD
    • They will ask what colors we can source for them as we get close
 
Thanks
Jacob Greenberg

VP, Merchandising

 

Harbour Outdoor
